title: Fixed V Open Table and Raised Corner Notch Press
description: One newly authored whole fixed compact manual corner-notcher-style exterior. A broad chamfered low sole supports a short rear spine and overhanging head above an empty horizontal worktable with a genuinely open V-shaped bite in its front edge. Two thick lower angled edge strips follow that opening. A separate complete raised V-shaped blunt upper jaw hangs from a short central ram between two upright side guides; its paired angled edges are visually distinct from a single wide sloping shear plate. Two short fixed table guide bars, full rear pivot cheeks and transverse pin, and one long raised hand lever with a dark terminal grip complete the compact whole tool. Not the existing broad floor-operated full-width plate shear, a paper trimmer or a sheet brake. All meshes newly authored; no old machine or blade imported. One static model zero scenes, no stock or workpiece. No sharpened cutting edge, shearing action, lever/ram kinematic closure, drive force, adjustment travel, guide accuracy, 90-degree cutting tolerance, capacity, mounting, manufacture, ergonomics, engineering or safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
